method: For every direct call to a proven WGSERVER import thunk, inspect the first bounded EAX use and classify zero tests, immediate comparisons, bit masks/transforms, address/index use, forwarding, overwrite, or control-boundary termination.
interpretation_limits: A zero/nonzero test proves only branchable machine-word semantics, not a native Boolean declaration.
Immediate comparisons support integer- or enum-like use but do not recover signedness or the complete value domain.
Bitmask operations support maskable machine-word use but do not recover flag ownership or names.
The bounded window may miss delayed uses, values copied through another register, or interprocedural consumers.
Exact return types and host implementations remain unavailable without matching Worldgroup binaries, symbols, headers, or dynamic traces.
